local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')

local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
getgenv().SelectedLuckyBlocks = {['All'] = true}
getgenv().AutoTakeLucky = false

local function cleanName(name)
    name = tostring(name or '')
    local cleaned = name:match('(.+)_%w+$')
    return cleaned or name
end

local function normalizeSelection(raw, valid)
    local out = {}
    local hasSpecific = false

    local function addName(name)
        if type(name) ~= 'string' then return end
        if not valid[name] then return end
        out[name] = true
        hasSpecific = hasSpecific or (name ~= 'All')
    end

    if type(raw) == 'string' then
        addName(raw)
    elseif type(raw) == 'table' then
        for _, v in pairs(raw) do
            if type(v) == 'string' then addName(v) end
        end
        for k, v in pairs(raw) do
            if type(k) == 'string' and v then addName(k) end
        end
    end

    if not hasSpecific and next(out) == nil then
        out['All'] = true
    end

    if hasSpecific then
        out['All'] = nil
    end

    return out
end

local function collectLuckyNames()
    local names = {'All'}
    local valid = {All = true}
    local dbFriends = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild('SharedModules')
        and ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules:FindFirstChild('Database')
        and ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules.Database:FindFirstChild('Friends')

    if dbFriends then
        for _, inst in ipairs(dbFriends:GetDescendants()) do
            local nm = tostring(inst.Name)
            if nm:match('Lucky Block$') and not valid[nm] then
                valid[nm] = true
                table.insert(names, nm)
            end
        end
    end

    table.sort(names, function(a, b)
        if a == 'All' then return true end
        if b == 'All' then return false end
        return a < b
    end)

    return names, valid
end

local luckyNames, luckyValid = collectLuckyNames()

local luckyDropdown = Value:AddDropdown('LuckyBlockSelector', {
    Title = 'Select Lucky Block',
    Values = luckyNames,
    Default = {'All'},
    Multi = true,
    Callback = function(V)
        getgenv().SelectedLuckyBlocks = normalizeSelection(V, luckyValid)
    end
})

local function hasSelectionFor(name)
    local selected = getgenv().SelectedLuckyBlocks
    if type(selected) ~= 'table' then return true end
    if selected['All'] then return true end
    return selected[name] == true
end

local function getTargetData(model)
    if not model or not model.Parent then return nil, nil end
    local root = model:FindFirstChild('RootPart', true)
    local prompt = root and root:FindFirstChild('StealPrompt') or model:FindFirstChild('StealPrompt', true)
    if root and prompt and prompt:IsA('ProximityPrompt') then
        return root, prompt
    end
    return nil, nil
end

local function pickTarget(friendsFolder, charRoot)
    local best = nil
    local bestDist = math.huge

    for _, item in ipairs(friendsFolder:GetDescendants()) do
        if item:IsA('Model') then
            local baseName = cleanName(item.Name)
            if baseName:match('Lucky Block$') and hasSelectionFor(baseName) then
                local root, prompt = getTargetData(item)
                if root and prompt then
                    local dist = (root.Position - charRoot.Position).Magnitude
                    if dist < bestDist then
                        bestDist = dist
                        best = item
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return best
end

Value:AddToggle('AutoTakeLucky', {
    Title = 'Auto Take',
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(V)
        getgenv().AutoTakeLucky = V

        if V then
            task.spawn(function()
                local currentTarget = nil

                while getgenv().AutoTakeLucky do
                    local character = lp.Character
                    local charRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                    if not charRoot then
                        task.wait(0.1)
                        continue
                    end

                    local holding = lp:GetAttribute('holdingFriend')
                    if holding ~= nil then
                        local mapParts = workspace:FindFirstChild('MAPPARTS')
                        local groundSign = mapParts and mapParts:FindFirstChild('GroundSign')
                        if groundSign and groundSign:IsA('BasePart') then
                            charRoot.CFrame = groundSign.CFrame
                        end
                        task.wait(0.1)
                        continue
                    end

                    local live = workspace:FindFirstChild('Live')
                    local friendsFolder = live and live:FindFirstChild('Friends')
                    if not friendsFolder then
                        task.wait(0.1)
                        continue
                    end

                    if not currentTarget or not currentTarget.Parent then
                        currentTarget = pickTarget(friendsFolder, charRoot)
                    else
                        local currentName = cleanName(currentTarget.Name)
                        if not currentName:match('Lucky Block$') or not hasSelectionFor(currentName) then
                            currentTarget = pickTarget(friendsFolder, charRoot)
                        end
                    end

                    if currentTarget then
                        local root, prompt = getTargetData(currentTarget)
                        if not root or not prompt then
                            currentTarget = nil
                            task.wait(0.05)
                            continue
                        end

                        while getgenv().AutoTakeLucky and currentTarget and currentTarget.Parent do
                            if lp:GetAttribute('holdingFriend') ~= nil then
                                break
                            end

                            root, prompt = getTargetData(currentTarget)
                            if not root or not prompt then
                                break
                            end

                            charRoot.CFrame = root.CFrame
                            fireproximityprompt(prompt)
                            task.wait(0.06)
                        end

                        if not currentTarget or not currentTarget.Parent then
                            currentTarget = nil
                        end
                    else
                        task.wait(0.08)
                    end

                    task.wait(0.02)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
})

local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')

local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
local remotesFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild('SharedModules')
    and ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules:FindFirstChild('Network')
    and ReplicatedStorage.SharedModules.Network:FindFirstChild('Remotes')
local placeFriendRemote = remotesFolder and remotesFolder:FindFirstChild('Place Friend')

getgenv().SelectedPlotLuckyDisplay = nil
getgenv().AutoPlaceLuckyInPlots = false

local plotDisplayToBase = {}
local plotDropdown

local backpackVersion = 0
local pendingRefreshAt = nil
local lastAppliedSignature = ''

local friendUIDCache = {base = nil, version = -1, data = {}}
local plotCache = {plot = nil, nextCheckAt = 0}
local setupCache = {plot = nil, data = {}, nextCheckAt = 0}

local function normalizeLuckyName(name)
    local n = tostring(name or '')
    n = n:gsub('%s*%b()%s*$', '')
    local cleaned = n:match('(.+)_%w+$')
    n = cleaned or n
    return n
end

local function getBackpack()
    return lp:FindFirstChild('Backpack')
end

local function markBackpackChanged()
    backpackVersion = backpackVersion + 1
    pendingRefreshAt = os.clock() + 3
end

local function buildBackpackLuckyData()
    local counts = {}
    local backpack = getBackpack()

    if backpack then
        for _, item in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
            local baseName = normalizeLuckyName(item.Name)
            if baseName:match('Lucky Block$') then
                counts[baseName] = (counts[baseName] or 0) + 1
            end
        end
    end

    local names = {}
    for baseName in pairs(counts) do
        table.insert(names, baseName)
    end
    table.sort(names)

    local displayValues = {}
    local mapping = {}
    local signatureParts = {}

    for _, baseName in ipairs(names) do
        local count = counts[baseName]
        local display = ('%s x%d'):format(baseName, count)
        table.insert(displayValues, display)
        mapping[display] = baseName
        table.insert(signatureParts, baseName .. ':' .. tostring(count))
    end

    if #displayValues == 0 then
        displayValues = {'None'}
        mapping['None'] = nil
    end

    local signature = table.concat(signatureParts, '|')
    return displayValues, mapping, signature
end

local function applyDropdownValues(force)
    local values, mapping, signature = buildBackpackLuckyData()
    if not force and signature == lastAppliedSignature then
        return
    end

    lastAppliedSignature = signature
    plotDisplayToBase = mapping

    local current = getgenv().SelectedPlotLuckyDisplay
    local stillValid = false
    if type(current) == 'string' then
        for _, v in ipairs(values) do
            if v == current then
                stillValid = true
                break
            end
        end
    end

    if not stillValid then
        getgenv().SelectedPlotLuckyDisplay = values[1]
    end

    if plotDropdown then
        pcall(function()
            if plotDropdown.Refresh then
                plotDropdown:Refresh(values)
            elseif plotDropdown.SetValues then
                plotDropdown:SetValues(values)
            end
        end)
    end
end

applyDropdownValues(true)
plotDropdown = Value:AddDropdown('PlotLuckySelector', {
    Title = 'Select Lucky Block',
    Values = (function()
        local vals = {}
        for display in pairs(plotDisplayToBase) do
            table.insert(vals, display)
        end
        table.sort(vals)
        if #vals == 0 then
            return {'None'}
        end
        return vals
    end)(),
    Default = getgenv().SelectedPlotLuckyDisplay,
    Multi = false,
    Callback = function(V)
        local selectedValue = V
        if type(V) == 'table' then
            selectedValue = V[1] or next(V)
        end
        getgenv().SelectedPlotLuckyDisplay = selectedValue
    end
})

local function reconnectBackpackSignals()
    local backpack = getBackpack()
    if not backpack then return end

    backpack.ChildAdded:Connect(markBackpackChanged)
    backpack.ChildRemoved:Connect(markBackpackChanged)
end

reconnectBackpackSignals()
lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(0.2)
    reconnectBackpackSignals()
    markBackpackChanged()
end)

local function getSelectedBaseName()
    local selectedDisplay = getgenv().SelectedPlotLuckyDisplay
    if type(selectedDisplay) ~= 'string' then return nil end
    return plotDisplayToBase[selectedDisplay]
end

local function getMyPlot()
    local now = os.clock()
    if now < plotCache.nextCheckAt and plotCache.plot and plotCache.plot.Parent then
        return plotCache.plot
    end

    local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild('Plots')
    if not plots then
        plotCache.plot = nil
        plotCache.nextCheckAt = now + 0.6
        return nil
    end

    local function norm(v)
        local s = tostring(v or '')
        s = s:gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', '')
        s = s:gsub('^@', '')
        return string.lower(s)
    end

    local myName = norm(lp.Name)
    local myDisplay = norm(lp.DisplayName)
    local myUserId = norm(lp.UserId)

    local function readOwner(inst)
        if not inst then return nil end

        local owner = inst:GetAttribute('owner')
        if owner == nil then owner = inst:GetAttribute('Owner') end

        if owner == nil then
            local ownerObj = inst:FindFirstChild('owner') or inst:FindFirstChild('Owner')
            if ownerObj then
                if ownerObj:IsA('StringValue') or ownerObj:IsA('IntValue') or ownerObj:IsA('NumberValue') then
                    owner = ownerObj.Value
                elseif ownerObj:IsA('ObjectValue') and ownerObj.Value then
                    owner = ownerObj.Value.Name
                else
                    owner = ownerObj:GetAttribute('Value')
                end
            end
        end

        return owner
    end

    local function ownerMatches(owner)
        if owner == nil then return false end
        local o = norm(owner)
        if o == '' then return false end
        return o == myName or o == myDisplay or o == myUserId
    end

    local matched = nil
    for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
        if ownerMatches(readOwner(plot)) then
            matched = plot
            break
        end

        for _, sub in ipairs(plot:GetChildren()) do
            if ownerMatches(readOwner(sub)) then
                matched = plot
                break
            end
        end
        if matched then break end
    end

    plotCache.plot = matched
    plotCache.nextCheckAt = now + 0.6
    return matched
end

local function collectSelectedFriendUIDs(baseLuckyName)
    if friendUIDCache.base == baseLuckyName and friendUIDCache.version == backpackVersion then
        return friendUIDCache.data
    end

    local result = {}
    local seen = {}
    if not baseLuckyName then
        friendUIDCache.base = baseLuckyName
        friendUIDCache.version = backpackVersion
        friendUIDCache.data = result
        return result
    end

    local backpack = getBackpack()
    if not backpack then
        friendUIDCache.base = baseLuckyName
        friendUIDCache.version = backpackVersion
        friendUIDCache.data = result
        return result
    end

    for _, item in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
        local baseName = normalizeLuckyName(item.Name)
        if baseName == baseLuckyName then
            local uid = item:GetAttribute('friendUID')
            if uid ~= nil then
                uid = tostring(uid)
                if uid ~= '' and not seen[uid] then
                    seen[uid] = true
                    table.insert(result, uid)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    friendUIDCache.base = baseLuckyName
    friendUIDCache.version = backpackVersion
    friendUIDCache.data = result
    return result
end

local function collectStandSetups(myPlot)
    local now = os.clock()
    if setupCache.plot == myPlot and now < setupCache.nextCheckAt then
        return setupCache.data
    end

    local result = {}
    local seen = {}
    if myPlot then
        local stands = myPlot:FindFirstChild('Stands')
        if stands then
            for _, stand in ipairs(stands:GetChildren()) do
                local setupAttr = stand:GetAttribute('setup')
                if setupAttr ~= nil then
                    local setupValue

                    if type(setupAttr) == 'boolean' then
                        if setupAttr then
                            setupValue = stand.Name
                        end
                    else
                        setupValue = tostring(setupAttr)
                    end

                    if setupValue and setupValue ~= '' and not seen[setupValue] then
                        seen[setupValue] = true
                        table.insert(result, setupValue)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    setupCache.plot = myPlot
    setupCache.data = result
    setupCache.nextCheckAt = now + 0.5
    return result
end

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        if pendingRefreshAt and os.clock() >= pendingRefreshAt then
            pendingRefreshAt = nil
            applyDropdownValues(false)
        end
        task.wait(0.12)
    end
end)

Value:AddToggle('AutoPlaceLuckyInPlots', {
    Title = 'Auto Place',
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(V)
        getgenv().AutoPlaceLuckyInPlots = V

        if V then
            task.spawn(function()
                while getgenv().AutoPlaceLuckyInPlots do
                    local selectedBase = getSelectedBaseName()
                    if not (selectedBase and selectedBase:match('Lucky Block$')) then
                        task.wait(0.18)
                        continue
                    end

                    if not placeFriendRemote then
                        task.wait(0.25)
                        continue
                    end

                    local myPlot = getMyPlot()
                    if not myPlot then
                        task.wait(0.2)
                        continue
                    end

                    local setups = collectStandSetups(myPlot)
                    local friendUIDs = collectSelectedFriendUIDs(selectedBase)

                    if #setups == 0 or #friendUIDs == 0 then
                        task.wait(0.18)
                        continue
                    end

                    for _, setupValue in ipairs(setups) do
                        for _, friendUID in ipairs(friendUIDs) do
                            if not getgenv().AutoPlaceLuckyInPlots then break end
                            placeFriendRemote:FireServer(tostring(setupValue), tostring(friendUID))
                            task.wait(0.01)
                        end
                        if not getgenv().AutoPlaceLuckyInPlots then break end
                    end

                    task.wait(0.16)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
})

    end

            local ownerObj = inst:FindFirstChild('owner') or inst:FindFirstChild('Owner')

                    owner = ownerObj.Value.Name
                else

                end
